Market today: The tech and chip sectors are facing a significant pullback, with AI-driven expectations cooling and leading to extended sell-offs. Leveraged ETFs in this space are seeing heavy losses, amplifying the downside.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.96%) and SPAL (-54.75%) are showing massive losses, and their listed stops are far above current prices, indicating they aren't protecting capital. SMH (-16.78%) also has a stop above its current price. QQQ (-5.48%) and QQQI (-7.69%) are nearing their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the overall tech/chip sector sentiment and your stops on QQQ and QQQI. Critically, re-evaluate the stops on your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and SMH.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management and stop discipline, especially with your leveraged and heavily underwater positions, as the tech pullback continues.
plays: Immediately check and adjust stops for SOXL, SPAL, and SMH. Their current listed stops are not protecting capital.
Consider trimming QQQ if it breaks its 670 stop, given the broader tech sell-off.
For a potential hedge, consider a short-term long on SOXS at 61.49-61.07 with a stop at 60.33, playing the chip rout.
